info.name: Excession Labs public security APIs
info.description: Public endpoints of Excession Labs (https://excessionlabs.ai) that answer today: the security headers checker and its MCP server on penetrationtestservices.com, and the provider dataset, search index, API catalog and MCP server on pentestcompare.com. No credentials are needed. The provider data is MIT. The header checker allows 12 requests per minute per IP.

request.description: Checks the response headers of one public URL. Sends one GET request per redirect and does not read the page body. Rate limit: 12 requests per minute per IP, so run it once, not in a loop. Set the `target` variable (default https://example.com).

exec: pm.test("Status is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
var j = pm.response.json();
pm.test("Result has the main keys", function () { pm.expect(j).to.include.all.keys("ok","checked_url","final_url","status","checked_at","hops","summary","checks"); });
pm.test("ok is true", function () { pm.expect(j.ok).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("summary has pass, warn, fail, info", function () { pm.expect(j.summary).to.include.all.keys("pass","warn","fail","info"); });
pm.test("checks include https, hsts and csp", function () { var ids = j.checks.map(function (c) { return c.id; }); pm.expect(ids).to.include.members(["https","hsts","csp"]); });
pm.test("each check has a valid status", function () { j.checks.forEach(function (c) { pm.expect(["pass","warn","fail","info"]).to.include(c.status); }); });

request.description: JSON-RPC call to the MCP server on penetrationtestservices.com. The tool check_security_headers takes a `url` argument and returns text in `content` and the same data as the REST endpoint in `structuredContent`. It shares the rate limit with the REST endpoint, so run it once.

exec: pm.test("Status is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
var j = pm.response.json();
pm.test("JSON-RPC 2.0 result with matching id", function () { pm.expect(j.jsonrpc).to.eql("2.0"); pm.expect(j.id).to.eql(3); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("result"); });
pm.test("Result is not an error", function () { pm.expect(j.result.isError).to.not.eql(true); });
pm.test("content[0] is text", function () { pm.expect(j.result.content[0].type).to.eql("text"); pm.expect(j.result.content[0].text).to.be.a("string").and.not.empty; });

pm.test("structuredContent has summary and checks", function () { pm.expect(j.result.structuredContent.ok).to.eql(true); pm.expect(j.result.structuredContent).to.include.all.keys("summary","checks","checked_url"); });

request.description: Full provider dataset, licensed MIT. Top-level keys: publisher, license, license_url, source, note, providers. Each provider has slug, name, website, type, delivery, scope, pricing_model, prices, turnaround, retesting and more. Unknown values read 'Not published'. Credit: Excession Labs, pentestcompare.com.

exec: pm.test("Status is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
var j = pm.response.json();
pm.test("Content-Type is JSON", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Content-Type")).to.include("application/json"); });
pm.test("Dataset metadata", function () { pm.expect(j.publisher).to.eql("Excession Labs"); pm.expect(j.license).to.eql("MIT"); pm.expect(j.license_url).to.be.a("string"); });
pm.test("providers is a non-empty array", function () { pm.expect(j.providers).to.be.an("array").that.is.not.empty; });

pm.test("Each provider has slug, name, website, delivery and scope", function () { j.providers.forEach(function (p) { pm.expect(p).to.include.all.keys("slug","name","website","delivery","scope"); }); });
pm.test("Slugs are unique", function () { var s = j.providers.map(function (p) { return p.slug; }); pm.expect(new Set(s).size).to.eql(s.length); });

request.description: The same provider data as one CSV file, licensed MIT. One row per provider, with a header row.

exec: pm.test("Status is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("Content-Type is CSV or text", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Content-Type")).to.match(/csv|text/); });
pm.test("Header row has slug, name, website", function () { var h = pm.response.text().split("\n")[0]; pm.expect(h).to.include("slug,name,website"); });
pm.test("More than one row", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text().trim().split("\n").length).to.be.above(1); });

request.description: Index of the pages on pentestcompare.com: a JSON array. Each entry has url, title, description, summary, section and layout.

exec: pm.test("Status is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
var j = pm.response.json();
pm.test("Body is a non-empty array", function () { pm.expect(j).to.be.an("array").that.is.not.empty; });

pm.test("Each entry has url, title, description, section", function () { j.forEach(function (e) { pm.expect(e).to.include.all.keys("url","title","description","section"); pm.expect(e.url).to.match(/^\//); }); });

request.description: API catalog as a linkset (application/linkset+json). Each entry has an anchor and links such as service-desc and service-doc.

exec: pm.test("Status is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
var j = pm.response.json();
pm.test("Content-Type is linkset+json", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Content-Type")).to.include("application/linkset+json"); });

pm.test("linkset is a non-empty array with anchors", function () { pm.expect(j.linkset).to.be.an("array").that.is.not.empty; j.linkset.forEach(function (l) { pm.expect(l.anchor).to.be.a("string"); }); });

request.description: JSON-RPC request that lists the tools of the MCP server on pentestcompare.com: search_site, get_page, how_to_contact, list_providers and get_provider.

exec: pm.test("Status is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
var j = pm.response.json();
pm.test("JSON-RPC 2.0 result with matching id", function () { pm.expect(j.jsonrpc).to.eql("2.0"); pm.expect(j.id).to.eql(1); });

pm.test("Tools include list_providers and get_provider", function () { var n = j.result.tools.map(function (t) { return t.name; }); pm.expect(n).to.include.members(["search_site","get_page","list_providers","get_provider"]); });
pm.test("Each tool has name, description, inputSchema", function () { j.result.tools.forEach(function (t) { pm.expect(t).to.include.all.keys("name","description","inputSchema"); }); });

request.description: JSON-RPC call to the list_providers tool. Optional arguments: delivery (human-led, hybrid or automated), scope (array of web_app, api, cloud, network, mobile, ai_apps; every listed scope must be 'yes') and published_prices_only (boolean). This example sends no arguments. The result is Markdown text in content[0].text, one line per provider.

exec: pm.test("Status is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
var j = pm.response.json();
pm.test("JSON-RPC 2.0 result with matching id", function () { pm.expect(j.jsonrpc).to.eql("2.0"); pm.expect(j.id).to.eql(2); });
pm.test("Result is not an error", function () { pm.expect(j.result.isError).to.not.eql(true); });

pm.test("content[0] is text with provider lines", function () { var t = j.result.content[0]; pm.expect(t.type).to.eql("text"); pm.expect(t.text).to.include("https://pentestcompare.com/providers/"); });
